description:
In this episode we discuss the very controversial subject of the compatibility of Biblical Christianity and Islam. We are joined by pastor Shahbaz B of Advent Lighthouse Ministries who converted from Islam to Biblical Christianity and we deliberate on questions such as can we say Allah and the God of the Bible are the same? How should we understand the Abrahamic accord between Christianity, Islam and Judaism? How can we minister to the people of Islam?

https://www.adventlighthouse.org/
